tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250yang zab thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i phyi sgrub kyi rgyun khyer rin chen snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 1$0000300phyogs dus rgyal ba rgya mtsho yi// dkyil 'khor kun 'dus bla ma dang*// gnyis su med la phyag 'tshal te// rgyun khyer rdo rje'i gsung bzhin 'god//

yang zab rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i phyi sgrub rgyun khyer du bya ba la sngon 'gro skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ na mo: rgyal ba rgya mtsho 'dus pa'i sku: bla ma thugs rje chen po la: bdag sogs 'gro kun byang chub bar: khyed shes dad pas skyabs su mchi: sems bskyed pa ni/ ho: mar gyur sems can thams cad kun: sangs rgyas go 'phang thob bya'i phyir: byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas: thugs rje chen po bsgrub par bgyi: dngos gzhi bskyed bzlas gnyis las thog mar bskyed rim yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bya ba ni/ hrī: stong nyid dbyings las snying rje'i gdangs: rang sems hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas: snod bcud phung khams dbyings su sbyangs: de yi ngang las 'byung rim steng: rdo rje'i srung 'khor gzhal med khang: mtshan rdzogs 'od zer 'bar ba'i nang: pad nyi zla steng nyi zla'i dbus: hrīḥdamar yongs gyur skad cig gis: rang nyid 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs: rgyal ba rgya mtsho sku mdog dmar: zhal gcig phyag bzhi zhi chags nyams: rtsa phyag thugs kar rdo rje bsdams: lhag ma phreng ba padma 'chang: gsang ba ye shes rā ga'i mdangs: ḍā ru thod pa bsnams pas 'khril: dar dang rin chen rus rgyan can: rdo rje padma'i skyil krung gis: snang stong 'od lnga'i klong na bzhugs: snyoms zhugs sbyor mtshams bde chen sprin: yi ge hūm̐ trāṃ oṃ āḥ'aphros: phyogs bzhir mi bskyod rin chen 'byung: rnam snang don grub spyan ras gzigs: mthing ser dkar dang ljang gu'i mdog: rang 'od yum dang mnyam par sbyor: rgyan dang phyag mtshan gtso bo ltar: 'od lnga'i thig le'i klong yangs su: pad zla'i steng na dgyes par bzhugs: sgo bzhir ha ri ni sa las: rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro las kyi mdog: gri gug thod 'dzin gar stabs kyis: pad nyi bam ro'i gdan la rol: gnas gsum zla nyi rdo rje la: 'bru gsum sku gsung thugs su rdzogs: thugs srog 'od dang bde ba'i ros:

ye shes 'khor lo spyan drangs gyur: badzra sa mā dza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: slar yang thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis: dbang lha spyan drangs dbang bskur gyur: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ke ta hrīḥhūm̐ trāṃ oṃ āḥ.a bhi ṣiñtsa mi: chu zhabs spyi bor brtan pa las: tshe dpag med sogs gtsor gyur pa'i: bde gshegs rigs lngas dbur brgyan gyur: ces gsal brtan dag gsum gyi ting nge 'dzin la rtse gcig tu bslabs nas/ yan lag tu bzlas pa bya ba ni/ gtso bo'i thugs kar pad nyi'i steng: ye shes sems dpa' rta mgrin dmar: padma bhañdza 'dzin pa yi: thugs kar zla steng hrīḥyig la: sngags kyis bskor las 'od zer 'phros: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs gsal bar byas: gtso 'khor kun gyi thugs srog las: 'od 'phros rtsa gsum mchod cing bskul: 'gro drug sgrib sbyangs lhar byas te: 'khor 'das dwangs bcud bdag la thim: dngos grub stsol zhing brtan par gyur: ces pa'i dmigs pa dang ma bral bar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ.oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐: zhes rtsa bsnyen la bzlas pa'i dngos gzhi bya/ bsnyen sgrub dril ba ni snga ma'i sham du/ dhu ma gha ye na ma swā hā: ha ri ni sa sarba siddhi hūm̐: zhes btags pa'ang ji ltar nus pa bzla/ rjes 'od gsal du 'jug cing ldang ba ni/ hūm̐: snod bcud lha dang gzhal yas khang: mkha' la sprin bzhin dbyings su thim: slar yang zung 'jug gnyug ma'i lha: sku gsung thugs kyi phyag rgyas mtshan: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī: bdag gi bsnyen bsgrubs dus gsum dge ba'i tshogs: mkha' khyab 'gro ba rnams kyi don du bsngo: kun kyang sa bcu lam lnga mthar phyin nas: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i go 'phang myur thob shog: ces bsngo smon gyis rgyas gdab par bya'o// 'di'ang rang gzhan nyer mkho khyer bde'i ched du gter chen bla ma rin po che las gnang ba zhus te/ padma gar dbang blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sdes rdzong shod bde gshegs 'dus pa'i pho brang du sbyar ba dge legs 'phel/// /
